wine/nvcuda/build-wine64.txt.text:
[binaries]
c = 'winegcc'
ar = 'ar'
strip = 'strip'

[built-in options]
c_args = ['-m64', '--no-gnu-unique', '-D__WINESRC__']
c_link_args = ['-m64', '-mwindows']

[properties]
needs_exe_wrapper = true
winelib = true

[host_machine]
system = 'linux'
cpu_family = 'x86_64'
cpu = 'x86_64'
endian = 'little'

build-win64.txt.text:
[binaries]
c = 'x86_64-w64-mingw32-gcc'
cpp = 'x86_64-w64-mingw32-g++'
ar = 'x86_64-w64-mingw32-ar'
strip = 'x86_64-w64-mingw32-strip'
windres = 'x86_64-w64-mingw32-windres'

[properties]
needs_exe_wrapper = true

[host_machine]
system = 'windows'
cpu_family = 'x86_64'
cpu = 'x86_64'
endian = 'little'

build-win32.txt.text:
[binaries]
c = 'i686-w64-mingw32-gcc'
cpp = 'i686-w64-mingw32-g++'
ar = 'i686-w64-mingw32-ar'
strip = 'i686-w64-mingw32-strip'
windres = 'i686-w64-mingw32-windres'

[properties]
needs_exe_wrapper = true

[host_machine]
system = 'windows'
cpu_family = 'x86'
cpu = 'x86'
endian = 'little'

build-win64.txt.text:
[binaries]
cpp = 'x86_64-w64-mingw32-g++'
strip = 'x86_64-w64-mingw32-strip'

[built-in options]

[properties]

build-win32.txt.text:
